title: Facilities Support
description:
Onsite role

Summary:
Serve as the primary front desk representative while supporting day-to-day office operations, facilities coordination, and employee services. This role is responsible for creating a professional and welcoming environment for visitors and employees, managing administrative and office support functions, coordinating vendors and workplace resources, and assisting with facilities operations to ensure a well-organized, efficient, and client-ready office environment. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, highly organized, proactive, and able to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.

title: Azure Architect
description:
Skills & Experience

  • Strong practical experience architecting, deploying, and supporting solutions on Microsoft Azure.
  • Proven ability to manage, monitor, optimize, and troubleshoot both Azure Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) environments in production.
  • In-depth knowledge of core Azure services and cloud infrastructure best practices.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), with Terraform as the primary automation tool.
  • Proficiency using Azure CLI and Python to automate cloud operations and infrastructure management.
  • Experience developing robust Python automation tools, reusable scripts, and workflow solutions beyond basic task automation.
  • Strong background building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and GitHub Workflows, following enterprise DevOps standards and best practices.
